<module id="serial2parallel">
    <description>Serial-to-Parallel Conversion Circuit</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="din_serial">Serial input data.</input>
        <input id="din_valid">Validity signal for input data.</input>
        <output id="dout_parallel" width_description="[7:0]">Parallel output data (8 bits wide).</output>
        <output id="dout_valid">Validity signal for the output data.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">Idle state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="RECEIVE">Receiving state.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">Counter to keep track of the number of received serial input data bits.</reg>
        <reg id="valid" width_description="[0:0]">Valid signal for the output data.</reg>
        <reg id="data" width_description="[7:0]">Register to store the parallel output data.</reg>
        
        // Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                valid <= 1'b0;
                data <= 8'd0;
            end else begin
                case(cnt)
                    4'd0: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[7] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    4'd1: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[6] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    4'd2: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[5] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    4'd3: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[4] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    4'd4: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[3] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    4'd5: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[2] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    4'd6: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[1] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    4'd7: begin
                        if(din_valid == 1'b1) begin
                            data[0] <= din_serial;
                            cnt <= cnt + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    default: begin
                        cnt <= 4'd0;
                        valid <= 1'b1;
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Sequential logic block triggered on the positive edge of clk or negative edge of rst_n. Counter keeps track of the number of received serial input data bits. Output data is stored in the register 'data' based on the value of 'cnt'. Valid signal is set to 1 when all 8 serial data bits have been received, otherwise it is set to 0.</implementation>
</module>
